verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a skills/plugin framework that layers on top of existing agent harnesses (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Devin, Hermes, etc.) and relies on those hosts' own tool-calling mechanisms; it doesn't itself function as an MCP client host into which a user plugs MCP servers. The evidence describes install mechanisms into other agents and skill-triggering, not an MCP client capability of Superpowers itself, so this axis is a category error for this kind of product.
